notes: Bug reports get their own tab on the Overview page (replaces the notifications tab), and bug-solved updates arrive as dashboard notifications instead of emails. All email types now send from the org's own connected account. Fully-paid pledges no longer show as partial or overdue. The donors page caps background requests so it can't freeze. Email templates gained a merge tag dropdown and an org-scope skip-campaigns picker. Donary webhook matches device donor numbers and routes by org without a secret key.
